## What am I doing?

Downloading the data of Fraser River Basin using R from BC Data Catalog.

## Code

Preparing a code snippet to download a data set.

```{r}

# Remove # from next line if you need to install tha packages.
# install.packages("bcdata", "sf", "dplyr")

# Loading required libraries
library(bcdata)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
```

Let's search for the data.

```{r}

bcdc_search("named watersheds")
```

```{r}

# Selecting the right ID to Check the required data
bcdc_get_record("ea63ea04-eab0-4b83-8729-f8a93ac688a1")

```

```{r}

# Now lets query to get some data
# Use the same ID that you finalized
data =  bcdc_query_geodata("ea63ea04-eab0-4b83-8729-f8a93ac688a1")
data
```

```{r}

bcdc_describe_feature("ea63ea04-eab0-4b83-8729-f8a93ac688a1")

```

```{r}

# Check your previous result to see the name of the basin
# In this data we require GNIS_NAME column that has fraser basin
fraser_check <- data |>
  filter(bcdata::CQL("GNIS_NAME ILIKE '%Fraser River%'")) |>
  select(GNIS_NAME) |>
  collect()


fraser_check
```

```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(sf)

ggplot(fraser_check) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = GNIS_NAME), colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "Watersheds matching 'Fraser'", fill = "GNIS_NAME") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

```
